adapterErrors: null on denied, revoked, privacy-restricted, missing, wrong encoding, query/hash mismatch, or corrupt snapshot; no disclosure of existence
normalization: sha256 of recursive sorted object keys; arrays retain normalized query order; decimal strings remain strings; requestId/idempotencyKey excluded from query and snapshot identity
summaryHash: sha256 canonical JSON of pinned shared FinancialSummary only, not wrapper or detail page
queryHash: full normalized scoped query, schema encoding, period, IANA timezone, environment/billing filters, currency/dimension filters, groupings, pageSize, effective asOf and reporting policy
snapshotHash: immutable full document binds normalized query, safe complete detail contributions, supplemental projection, canonical per-currency mapping, immutable input references, source coverage, producer revision and watermark
pageSemantics: snapshotReader returns authoritative FIRST page using stored pageSize; rejects snapshot originally created via v2. A submitted continuation page is not byte-identical to first page and must be rejected by v1 export envelope comparison, or caller resubmits first page. Aggregate canonical summary/hash is constant across pages.
freshAuthority: current reporting.querySummary / finance.summary.read before lookup and after DB waits/result; export must independently authorize integrations.exportSummary / finance.summary.export
limitations: UUID scope and exactly one observed currency for legacy reader
Product approvals, complete billing/revenue/cash sources and production host adapter remain externally pending
No conversion of opaque authority IDs
HMAC key rotation changes cursor bytes and invalidates old cursors; export caller obtains a refreshed first page
